text: Doubling width cut the 6000-step N=64 vs N=128 force gap by about 25-40% (0.143 to 0.108, and 0.072 to 0.045), with accel_step unchanged. If both d128 arms are read at matched val_mse_ratio, or trained to 12000 steps, does the gap keep shrinking with width, as a capacity bottleneck would predict? Or does it stay at or above 0.04, as a width-independent steps_per_orbit ceiling would?
